name: Marketing agent
hero_sub: It finds what works on TikTok, makes clips, posts them from our account and learns from the numbers.

starters.label: See what we learned about the winning format
See our clips and how each one is doing
Ask it to write and render the next batch
starters.text: Write the next batch of scripts in the winning format, explain for each one why it should work, tell me what rendering will cost, then render the best 5 at 720p and hold anything that must not go out.

opening: Show me where the campaign stands.
setup: (command -v mkt >/dev/null || pip install -q -e .) && mkt sync pull
